results.question: What is the total cohort users, total revenue, and average LTV per user grouped by acquisition source in LTV cohorts mart?
results.golden_sql: SELECT acquisition_source, SUM(total_users_in_cohort) AS total_users, SUM(total_cohort_revenue) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(ltv_per_user), 2) AS avg_ltv_per_user FROM `apex-activewear.gold_layer.mart_ltv_cohorts` GROUP BY acquisition_source ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
results.generated_sql:
SELECT
  acquisition_source,
  SUM(total_users_in_cohort) AS total_cohort_users,
  ROUND(SUM(total_cohort_revenue), 2) AS total_revenue,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(total_cohort_revenue), SUM(total_users_in_cohort)), 2) AS avg_ltv_per_user
FROM `apex-activewear.gold_layer.mart_ltv_cohorts`
GROUP BY acquisition_source
ORDER BY total_cohort_users DESC;
results.judge_reason: The generated query computes avg_ltv_per_user as a weighted ratio (SUM(revenue)/SUM(users)), whereas the ground truth uses AVG(ltv_per_user) across cohort rows, so the headline metric returns different values.
